name: mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Full Profile
description: HUPO-PSI mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Full Profile requiring all four core sections (metadata, smallMoleculeSummary, smallMoleculeFeature, and smallMoleculeEvidence) along with both summary and feature quantification units

$.description: Root-level section requirements for a complete mzTab-M document containing all four core sections

requirements.description: A complete mzTab-M document MUST define metadata, smallMoleculeSummary, smallMoleculeFeature, and smallMoleculeEvidence sections

$.metadata.small_molecule-quantification.description: Metadata MUST define small_molecule-quantification_unit as a valid ontology CV term or user-defined parameter

value_constraint.description: Small molecule quantification unit must be a valid CV term (user-defined terms allowed)

$.metadata.small_molecule_feature-quanti.description: Metadata MUST define small_molecule_feature-quantification_unit as a valid ontology CV term or user-defined parameter

value_constraint.description: Small molecule feature quantification unit must be a valid CV term (user-defined terms allowed)

$.smallMoleculeSummary.description: The smallMoleculeSummary (SML) table MUST be present and contain at least one summary row

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 entry in smallMoleculeSummary

$.smallMoleculeFeature.description: The smallMoleculeFeature (SMF) table MUST be present and contain at least one feature row

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 entry in smallMoleculeFeature

$.smallMoleculeEvidence.description: The smallMoleculeEvidence (SME) table MUST be present and contain at least one evidence row

value_constraint.description: Requires at least 1 entry in smallMoleculeEvidence
